questions.claim: had 6 parse failures from reasoning text prepended to JSON output

All 10 failed tests have outputs starting with 'Thinking:' but JSON was successfully parsed for 9 of them — the verdicts just didn't match.

questions.question: The eval was run during the introductory period, but promptfoo charged at standard rate. Which should the draft cite? The introductory price ($5.95) or the actual cost charged ($8.92)?
